{"title":"Implement Reverse(s string) string helper with table test","class":"implement","description":"In the Go module in the current directory (package calc), create reverse.go with a function Reverse(s string) string that returns s with its runes reversed (correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 runes like emojis and non-ASCII). {"title":"Implement IsEven(n int) bool helper with table test","class":"implement","description":"In the Go module in the current directory (package calc), create even.go with a function IsEven(n int) bool that reports whether n is even.
